text.tspan: One binary language: quiet microtype fields, generous clear space and neutral information bands.
Lead Developer / Product Manager - Marcin Kordyaczny
Use an 8 px spacing rhythm with 4 px adjustments
for controls. Use small binary digits as a background
texture, never a large standalone numeral or
workflow steps a readable sequence. Keep forms
and data free of decoration; access screens may
The bytes spell FNLLA in ASCII, not live data or AI
memory. Use grouped Mono octets, #DCE9FC on
white or light grey, with row breaks and fading
edges. Keep the digits small and evenly spaced,
without shaping them into a second symbol. Protect
reading areas, logo clear space and QR quiet zones.
Use light-grey information bands for social headers
and repository art. Retain blue for marks, literal
addresses and small rules; print may use a strong
blue band. Diagrams explain actual boundaries, not
invented UI. Keep their key claims in adjacent
Markdown and descriptive alt text. Use neutral,
